title: Act: Add gridToRgba to the art module
description: Create the pure module converting a palette-indexed grid into RGBA bytes using PALETTE from src/lib/palette.ts.
acceptance_criteria: gridToRgba returns width, height and RGBA data for valid grids.
Out-of-range or non-integer indices throw RangeError.
technical_constraints: Reuse PALETTE; do not redefine colours (shared palette, max 48).
definition_of_done: Module compiles under tsc --noEmit and exports PixelGrid, TRANSPARENT and gridToRgba.

steps.action: Create the file importing PALETTE from '../lib/palette'. Export type PixelGrid = readonly (readonly number[])[], export const TRANSPARENT = -1, and a local hexToRgb(hex) returning [r,g,b] parsed from the 6 hex digits after '#'.
steps.expected: File compiles with the three declarations.

steps.action: Export gridToRgba(grid: PixelGrid): { width: number; height: number; data: Uint8ClampedArray }. height = grid.length, width = grid[0]?.length ?? 0. Throw Error if any row length differs from width. Allocate Uint8ClampedArray(width*height*4). For each cell: if value === TRANSPARENT leave zeros; else if !Number.isInteger(value) or value<0 or value>=PALETTE.length throw RangeError with the value, x and y; else write hexToRgb(PALETTE[value]) and alpha 255 at offset (y*width+x)*4.
steps.code: export function gridToRgba(grid: PixelGrid) { /* as described */ }
steps.expected: gridToRgba([[0,1],[2,-1]]) returns width 2, height 2, 16 bytes with the last pixel alpha 0.
